_comment: MCP servers added to every session in the container (scope: user).
The entrypoint registers them with `claude mcp add-json --scope user`, once per config
volume - tracked in ~/.claude/.harness-mcp-installed. Removing a server with
`claude mcp remove` is permanent: the entrypoint does not add it again.
Deleting an entry from this file unregisters the server on the next container start.
Why not managed settings: `managedMcpServers` accepts only http/sse servers
('command is not allowed in managed settings'), and managed-mcp.json takes
EXCLUSIVE control over MCP, silencing every other server.
No Playwright here: the browser is handled by `playwright-cli` (see docs).
